item.text: [{"task_id":"d47aa2ff","source_lines":["def run(params, grid, demos):","    separator = int(round(params['rule'][0]))","    background = int(round(params['rule'][1]))","    added = int(round(params['rule'][2]))","    removed = int(round(params['rule'][3]))","    axis = int(round(params['rule'][4]))","    gap = int(round(params['rule'][5]))","    if axis not in (0, 1) or gap < 1:","        return grid.copy()","    work = grid.T if axis == 0 else grid","    dividers = np.where(np.all(work == separator, axis=0))[0]","    if len(dividers) != 1:","        return grid.copy()","    split = int(dividers[0])","    left = work[:, :split].copy()","    right = work[:, split + gap:]","    if left.shape != right.shape:","        return grid.copy()","    changed = left != right","    result = np.where(changed, np.where(left == background, added, removed), left)","    return result.T if axis == 0 else result"],"shapes":{"rule":[6]},"params":{"rule":[5,0,1,2,1,1]},"rationale":"Split at the gray divider and compare corresponding cells.
